label: M2
execution_safety: approved only for frozen controlled synthetic fixtures; no user files
safety_notes: No network, subprocess, shell, eval, secret/environment reads or dependency install
Root realpath and ordinary-file-only inspection; state symlink refusal and state path containment
All tested plans have own generated IDs; tamper fixture changes only filename target and checks containment
Confirm required before apply/undo, whole-plan content/collision checks, O_EXCL plan/receipt writes
State written below explicit assigned root; rename operations use bare filename validation
source_risks_not_runtime_claims: Receipt path constructs receipts/<plan_id>.json from editable plan id without re-validating that id; crafted path-bearing id may escape root. Frozen F05 edits filename, not id, so this risk is not certified by its pass
Preflight existence checks followed by os.rename are not no-replace atomic against an external concurrent filesystem writer; concurrency explicitly outside application scope
